To calculate a simple ROI given gross margin and cost of sales, you can use the following formula:

ROI = (Gross Margin - Cost of Sales) / Cost of Sales

In this formula, gross margin is the revenue minus the cost of goods sold, and cost of sales is the direct costs incurred to produce the goods or services sold.

For example, if your gross margin is $150,000 and your cost of sales is $100,000, your simple ROI would be:

ROI = ($150,000 - $100,000) / $100,000
ROI = $50,000 / $100,000
ROI = 0.5 or 50%

This means that for every dollar you spent on producing and selling your product, you earned fifty cents in profit or ROI.
